rows.en: (Alright, I brought a packed lunch today!)
Ooh! You've got something tasty-looking there!

Geez...
Students eating better than their teachers...
The world's going to the dogs.
Oh, would you like one?
rows.notes: Male scene. Offering one piece of the lunch.

rows.en:
You idiot!
A teacher can't go accepting handouts from a student!
Oh, sorry. Then I'll just...
rows.notes: Male scene. Trails off; Gary cuts in.

rows.en:
Well, if you insist that much,
I guess I could take some.

Mm, this rolled omelet's not bad.
Now, let's try that fried chicken too...
Ah!? Wha!? No way...

Phew, not half bad, that lunch of yours.
See ya!

(Gary-sensei...
One way or another, he ate about half of it...)
(Yay, I brought a packed lunch today!)
Want to try a little of this?
Oh, I'm sorry. Then I'll just...

(Gary-sensei...
One way or another, he ate half of it...)

(Okay, classes are finally over.
Guess I'll head home.)

Hey, \p!
Good timing running into you.
Oh, Gary-sensei. What's up?

I was just needing an extra pair of hands.
Come with me a sec.

So here's the deal. I'd like you to service
all 20 of these EX-Gear units here.
Um, that many is really a bit much...

...Yeah, figured.
Oh well, you can go home, then!
Nah, I can just leave it to a contractor anyway.
Huh? Then why not do that from the start...

You idiot, then the contracting fee would...
Oops...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. He lets slip something about the contracting fee and stops.

rows.en: Huh? Sensei? What was that?
You idiot! I said that's enough, just go home!
(How serious was Gary-sensei, anyway...)

(Alrighty, classes are finally over.
Time to head home.)
Oh, Gary-sensei. What is it?
Umm... that many is really a bit much...
But if that's the case, then from the start...
Huh? Sensei? Contracting fee?
(I wonder how serious Gary-sensei was...)

(What a surprise. Who'd have thought
the "Galactic Fairy" Sheryl Nome
would transfer to Mihoshi...)

Hey, \p.
Come over here a sec...
Huh? What is it, Gary-sensei?

Since Sheryl came to Mihoshi, the whole Academy
has been in a tizzy. You've noticed that too, right?

Well, she IS the Galactic Fairy.
Isn't that kind of unavoidable?

You idiot!
You didn't come to Mihoshi
to goof off, did you?!

You all came to Mihoshi to become experts,
didn't you? And yet just because Sheryl
transferred here, you're all getting carried away...
(Gary-sensei...)

...You're right.
I guess I got a little carried away too.

So I never forget why I came here,
please keep drilling me hard from now on,
Gary-sensei!!
Heh, as long as you understand.

(Gary-sensei really is a teacher after all.
I'm kind of moved.)

...So, go tell Sheryl's manager, the rumored
beauty, that there's a teacher here who cares
this much about his students. Casually, now.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. The manager is not named here; Grace is female per the glossary, but the line needs no pronoun.

rows.en:
Heh heh, with this, even Sheryl's manager
will notice my charms......
rows.notes: Shared male/female. manejaa-san: -san on a job title, dropped as in c23350.

rows.en: (I was an idiot to be moved by Gary-sensei...)

...You're right.
I guess I got a little carried away too.
(I was an idiot to be moved by Gary-sensei...)

(Summer vacation's finally half over.
What should I do with the second half...)

Hm, \p, what's the matter?
Why such a grave look...?

Oh, it's nothing that serious, but...
I was just wondering how to spend
the rest of summer vacation...

All I can tell you is to spend it
however you like.
Huh? Sensei, that's...

It would be pointless for me to force anything
on you. Find it yourself. Consider that one
of your assignments.
Y-yes!

At school you only ever do what you're told.
So at least over summer vacation, think and
decide things for yourself. Understood?!
(Hilda-sensei is weirdly convincing...)

(Summer vacation's finally half over.
What should I do with the rest...)

Oh, it's nothing that serious, but...
I was just wondering how I should spend
the rest of summer vacation...

(Whatever Hilda-sensei says,
she's weirdly convincing...)

uncertain: c16413/c16421: Gary's slip about the contracting fee (itaku ryoukin) is left as vague as the Japanese.
c16436: manejaa-san rendered 'Sheryl's manager' without -san, as in finished line c23350.
